# Open Questions

## Purpose

Track unresolved questions so agents do not convert assumptions into
requirements.

| ID | Question | Priority | Owner | Status | Resolution Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q-001 | TBD | Critical | TBD | Open | TBD |

## Priority

Use Critical, Important, or Later. Critical questions block the next gate.
Important questions must be resolved before release. Later questions stay
visible.
